note: Named scenic and legendary roads. `line` is drawn geometry and is ONLY present where a real road-following shape is known. `anchors` are ordered planning points - towns, passes, junctions - and are NEVER joined into a line and shown as a road, because a straight line between two passes is not the road between them. Routes carrying anchors only are named and located on the map but not drawn until the nightly resolves their true geometry from OpenStreetMap. Atlas records © their listed sources; OSM-derived geometry is ODbL. Geometry from the CurveScout global scenic-road file, 2026: corridor control lines, not turn-by-turn road geometry. The app snaps them to real tarmac where one of its own rides runs along them, and draws them as an indicative thread elsewhere.
